biggest_catch: Membership restricted to South Florida counties, and the bonus is paid two months after account opening.
catches: You earn $125 and your referral earns $125 per qualifying new-member referral; official page: 'NO LIMIT to how many people you can refer'.
Referral must open savings + checking with at least a $300 direct deposit per month, OR savings + a share certificate (CD).
Both accounts must stay open in active use and good standing for at least 60 days; funds deposited two months after account opening.
Referrals must be submitted prior to account opening; new member cannot have been a signer on any MPS CU checking/savings in the prior six months.
Separate loan-referral payout: $100 each for closed loans over $10,000; $50 each for $5,000–$10,000; paid within 30 days of closing.
Membership open to those who live, work, or worship in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Martin, St. Lucie, or Monroe counties; employees and board members excluded.

steps: Complete the referral form before your friend opens their account.
Your friend opens a qualifying savings + checking account with $300/month direct deposit (or savings + CD).
Accounts stay open in good standing for 60 days.
You receive $125 two months after account opening.
timing: Funds deposited two months after account opening.
when_cash_arrives: Funds deposited two months after account opening. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
